purpose: Resolve the exact latest stable GloBI archive record and interaction-file byte identities before any interaction row is read.
allowed_operations: file-name, byte-size, checksum and download-link inspection
forbidden_operations: download or decompress interaction data files
read TSV/CSV headers from archive content
inspect coordinates or dates from interaction rows
file_candidate_rule: Filename must contain interaction (case-insensitive) and end in .tsv, .tsv.gz, .csv, .csv.gz or .zip. If multiple candidates exist, retain all as candidates until a separate schema-only gate selects one before row content is opened.
next_gate_if_pass: Freeze schema from public GloBI field definitions and archive file metadata before any full-file download.
next_gate_if_hold: Stop the primary joint interaction route; finite source family is exhausted.
